boundaries: Unmodified pinned Hermes and the actual non-root/read-only production WebUI image. Only model decisions use a deterministic endpoint.

Sudo uses a disposable CI account authorised only for /usr/bin/id. Approval targets are disposable canary directories. Secret setup uses an external fixture skill configured through the supported Hermes CLI.
No access to the operator host or Hermes state/config files. Fresh native skill execution verifies secret availability without WebUI filesystem inspection.

Pending sudo/secret forms cannot be authoritatively reconstructed after disconnect at this upstream pin. Old forms are non-actionable; Stop response and an explicitly requested fresh turn provide an in-WebUI recovery path.

At most five live conversation projections in one tab; hidden transcripts are discarded, entered credentials are not retained. Six earlier activity turns and bounded output are transient, not a durable history database.
Active-session inventory is capped at 100 rows; approval detail probing is bounded to 12 working runtimes per refresh. This does not claim unlimited-concurrency monitoring.

Browser tests use synthetic protocol fixtures and mobile emulation. Physical-device keyboards, installed PWA, full release security/performance certification and the existing upstream reasoning-scope race remain separate open gates.
